Rough rev-1 milestone: one JLC order (5 boards, 2-3 assembled) + one pair's parts. Known parts $38 + one-time $90-200 + TBD items (cells, transducers, connector).

**Risk: the STM32U575CIU6Q had only 8 in stock at JLC on 2026-10-01.**
